title: TVET Colleges — Centres of Excellence
summary: Structural engineering for upgraded dormitories, classrooms and training facilities at eight technical colleges under the ADB-funded Improved TVET for Employment Project.
body:
As structural engineers on the ADB-funded Improved TVET for Employment Project, RNL is helping deliver upgraded infrastructure at technical colleges across the country: gender-responsive dormitories, modern classrooms and technical training facilities.

## Participating institutions

- Port Moresby Technical College
- Hagen Technical College
- Goroka Technical College
- Madang Technical College
- Lae Polytechnic Institute
- Simbu Don Bosco Technical
- West New Britain Technical
- Bougainville Technical College
